title: Cost-aware trace handoff and weekly standup
content:
Weekly standup & handoff notes — Observability 
Date: 2027-09-16
Facilitator: Elena Morris
Attendees: Elena, Samir, Ruth, Jonah, Priya (plus async notes from A. Chen)

Purpose: rapid sync on tracing, dashboard changes, and cost telemetry experiments; capture decisions, owners, and next steps for on-call handoff.

1) Quick state (1–2 sentences each)
- Samir: adaptive-sampling experiment running on staging, 72h window. Found heavy spike from legacy job: ~45k spans/min at 03:00 UTC.
- Ruth: dashboard baseline card redesign merged to staging (PR 872), working on 2 small accessibility fixes.
- Jonah: trace ingestion pipeline memory leak narrowed to shard-3; root cause likely histogram aggregation bug. Patch in review (OBS-4982).
- Priya: cost telemetry alerts tuning — reduced false positives for volume alerts by adding service-level rate limits.

2) Observations & data highlights
- Traces-per-minute (prod): median 12k, p95 39k, peak 74k (09/14 03:12 UTC).
- Average cost per 1k traces (ingest + retention): estimated $0.78 (current config). Goal: $0.30–0.45 after sampling + heatmap pruning.
- High-cardinality spans contributing most to cost: user-metadata-enrichment, batch-annotator, model-shard-router.
- Sampling bias check (staging): adaptive sampler reduced tail-span retention by ~38% while preserving error-rate-correlated traces (per evaluation harness).

3) Decisions made
- Move forward with multi-phase rollout of adaptive quantile sampler: staging -> canary (5% traffic) -> 30% -> 100% (expected 3-week ramp). Owner: Samir (JIRA OBS-5041).
- Dashboard baseline cards will show both sampled and unsampled counts for first two weeks after rollout to validate downstream metrics. Owner: Ruth.
- Backfill plan: do NOT backfill sampled traces into anomaly training set; instead snapshot features at sampler decision-time for replay. Action item to spec. Owner: Priya.

4) Blockers and open questions (notes to self)
- Blocker: histogram aggregator OOM reproduces only under long-lived load (>24h). Jonah needs dedicated repro harness. (temp mitigation: shard throttling at 10k rpm).
- Question: what is acceptable delta for SLI (error/latency) when applying sampling? Current target is <1% delta on error-rate correlation. Is that still ok for product teams? Need confirmation from platform teams.
- Unknown: retention economics for high-cardinality spans if we enable per-tenant quota caps. Finance needs a simple per-tenant model to approve quotas. Elena to loop in Cal (Finance).

5) Action items (short list with owners & ETA)
- Samir: deploy adaptive-sampling canary (5%) by 2027-09-18; create postmortem checklist for sampler rollbacks if p99 error correlates increase >1.5x. (OBS-5041)
- Jonah: finish patch for histogram aggregator, add unit+load test, and open release candidate by 2027-09-20. (PR link in linked_artifacts)
- Ruth: update staging dashboards to include sampled/unsampled counters and quick toggle; complete by 2027-09-19.
- Priya: draft runbook section for "sampling & downstream ML training" including feature-snapshotting approach, due 2027-09-22.
- Elena: schedule 30-minute sync with Finance & Product to align on quota model and SLI acceptance criteria; invite Cal and Mina; target 2027-09-17.

6) Experiment details (notes for replication)
- Adaptive quantile sampler config: target throughput reduction 40–55% (start q=0.7), decision window 15s, min-retain per-trace 1, max-retain 10.
- Metric hooks: add "sampler.decision" tag to exported spans (done in staging), emit "sampler.rate_applied" metric at 1s cadence.
- Validation harness: run 1000 synthetic error scenarios across service-matrix; compare AUC for anomaly detector with/without sampling.

7) Dashboard work & UX notes
- Baseline card redesign: show: total traces, sampled traces, sampling rate, ingestion cost estimate, top-5 high-cardinality ops. Toggle to show historical estimated cost impact.
- Accessibility: color contrast needs adjust for small-multiples; Ruth to push fix PR.

8) Cost telemetry & alerting
- New alert: "ingest-rate-cost-spike" with two-stage trigger: (a) sudden volume > 2x baseline for 5m AND (b) projected ingest cost > $1k/hr. Test run scheduled in staging next week.
- Short term threshold adjustments: reduce sensitivity on small tenants (<1% traffic) to avoid churn.

9) On-call handoff notes (for next shift)
- If shard-3 OOMs: set throttle to 5k rpm and page Jonah; escalate to site-reliability if persists >15m.
- If sampler canary shows >1% delta in error correlation compared to control: rollback to previous sampler config and notify product owners; trigger incident retrospective.
- Emergency contact: Samir (pager), Jonah (pager), Elena (backup).

10) Misc / Brainstorm (freeform)
- Consider a lightweight pre-ingest filter for obvious noise (bot crawlers, synthetic checks) at the load balancer to avoid ingestion cost entirely. Prototype idea: 1–2% false positive allowed if it saves 20% ingest cost.
- Long-term: expose per-tenant budget controls in Console (product ask). Start discovery with Product in Q4.

Notes to self (scratch):
- Follow up with ML team about training set snapshotting semantics (email @ml-platform).
- Capture more realistic cost numbers by running a 7-day sim of the adaptive sampler configs against prod traffic shapes (job for infra team).

Next meeting: brief async check-in Friday 2027-09-17; full sync Tues 2027-09-21 (planning for canary ramp).

Attachments: staging trace snippets, sampler config YAML (linked in PR 872), experiment logs (s3://redwood-observability/experiments/adaptive-sampler/2027-09-15/).

End of notes.

-- Elena M.
